author: Oilerator
body:
Hello this is a appeal for my friend Knight187 that got banned for hacking on your server these are his words. He cannot do it himself, because when he try's to make a forum account it just says waiting after he join the specified server. These are his words why he wishes to get unbanned. I realize hacking is wrong it ruins the game for other players, and it is a game about blocks. I never knew why I hacked that day because I'm really good at PvP and stuff when I'm not hacking. I wish I never hacked on your server it is wrong to hack and I hate hackers my self. I hate myself for that one day I hacked on your great server. I would kindly like to be unbanned because hacking is wrong and I don't know why I ever did it. I hope you see and respond to this appeal and see how sorry I am for hacking your server -Sincerely Knight187 (My in game name is Knight187 if I do get unbanned^-^)



I already appealed for him before. But it got denied because I didnt wait long enough to appeal... I think it was 5-7 months that you had to wait to appeal.... He was banned in May, so its been 5 months... I dont know if this is long enough since the last appeal, but he really likes this server.... Also, this is the same appeal message that he made from last time... Does he have to make a new one?



-Oilerator

Thanks.
